subject: Quality Signals Integration and Canary Strategy for Helio Health
messages:
From: Eva Lopez <eva.lopez@heliohealth.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: devops@heliohealth.com
Date: Tue, 14 May 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quality Signals Integration & Canary Strategy — Helio Health

Hi Monica,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Helio's product team is excited to move forward with Redwood for runtime and quality monitoring. Attached is a short requirements doc that outlines our goals: prompt-level regression detection, an eval harness we can run in our CI, and a lightweight canary/rollback cadence for releases.

High level asks:
- Help us define the initial prompt sets (clinical triage & billing assistant).
- Integrate Redwood eval hooks into our CI so regressions are visible pre-prod.
- Propose canary thresholds (latency, token-level quality deltas) and a rollback playbook.

Can we target a technical kickoff Thursday or Friday this week? Our devops lead (cc'ed) can join for network/VPC questions.

Attachments: helio-qmon-requirements.pdf

Best,
Eva Lopez
Product Manager — Helio Health
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Eva Lopez <eva.lopez@heliohealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 May 2029 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quality Signals Integration & Canary Strategy — Helio Health

Eva — thanks for the clear brief and the PDF. Really excited to partner on this.

Proposed next steps (mutual action plan attached):
1) Technical kickoff (45m): Thu 2029-05-16 10:00am PT — attendees: Helio devops, product, Redwood CS (Marissa), Redwood QA (Ben), Redwood infra lead.
2) Prompt set curation: Helio provides seed prompts + acceptance criteria; Redwood CS and Eval team will map and expand to ~120 prompts across two verticals.
3) Eval harness: We’ll provide an eval-hook PR for Helio’s CI runners and a baseline regression suite.
4) Canary policy: initial thresholds (suggested): 3% drop in intent accuracy OR 15% increase in median latency over baseline -> pause rollout and trigger rollback. We’ll define exact metrics in kickoff.

I attached a mutual action plan spreadsheet with owners and dates. Ben will take point on the eval harness integration. Marissa will manage the prompt curation and post-onboard QMon alerts.

Attachments: redwood-mutual-action-plan.xlsx

Thanks — see you Thu if that works.

—Monica
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Eva Lopez <eva.lopez@heliohealth.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 May 2029 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quality Signals Integration & Canary Strategy — Helio Health

Eva / team — quick technical note ahead of kickoff to make the meeting efficient:

Prompt sets and eval harness notes
- Prompt seeds we need: canonical customer utterances, edge cases, hallucination-sensitive prompts (e.g., insurance codes). Please label prompts with acceptance criteria and expected entity sets.
- Our recommended split: 70% functional (intent/entity), 30% regression/robustness (adversarial/perturbed).
- Eval hooks: we’ll open a draft PR against your CI repo (link below) that runs the eval suite in a sandbox job and posts results as a JSON artifact. The job will also push key metrics to Redwood’s eval ingestion endpoint for visualizations in Console.

Canary & rollback specifics (draft):
- Canary window: 2 hours for initial rollouts, increasing to 24 hours for larger traffic ramps.
- Stop conditions: 3% absolute drop in primary intent F1 OR >4% of prompts flagged as differing by more than 0.2 score points vs baseline.
- Automatic rollback: If stop condition met twice within 24 hours we will initiate an automated rollback to prior pinned model variant and notify CS + DevOps.

Pre-kickoff asks for Helio:
- Share a short sample set (10–20 prompts) for each vertical so Ben can pre-run local baselines.
- Confirm CI access pattern (service account or deploy key) for the eval job.

Links: Eval repo (draft): https://github.com/redwood-inference/qmon-integration/tree/helio-health

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Engineer, Redwood Inference

Thanks — the Thursday slot works for us. A couple of items before the call:
- We attached an extract of representative prompts to the requirements PDF (see page 4). Should be enough for Ben to run a quick baseline.
- For CI access, we prefer a deploy key pattern (we’ll provision a read-only key for the eval job).
- One security ask: can you confirm whether eval artifacts include any PII and how Redwood recommends redaction / retention? We’re SOC2-aligned and need a note for procurement.

We’ll be on the kickoff Thu 10:00am PT.

Best,
Eva
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Eva Lopez <eva.lopez@heliohealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 16 May 2029 15:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quality Signals Integration & Canary Strategy — Helio Health

Perfect — see you at 10am PT. Quick answers to Eva's pre-call questions so we can hit the ground running:

Security & artifacts
- Eval artifacts: by default artifacts contain prompt id, prompt text (if you opt in), model outputs, and metric deltas. We support a redaction pipeline: Helio can elect to redact prompt text via a one-line flag in the eval job (recommended for PHI).
- Retention: default 90 days for eval artifacts in our hosted Console; for Private/Dedicated customers we can support shorter retention or customer-managed storage. We’ll include the retention options in the procurement worksheet.

Canary/rollback clarifications
- We’ll keep the initial canary conservative. Automation will be gated — a manual approval step before automatic rollback for the first two releases unless your team requests fully automatic rollback.

Deliverables for kickoff (uploaded to Drive):
- redwood-mutual-action-plan.xlsx (owners + dates)
- eval-harness-integration-notes.md (CI hook checklists)
- helio-qmon-requirements.pdf (your doc)

HubSpot deal link: HubSpot: deal/HL-2029-0421

Thanks — Monica
